title: Custom Colored Character Title
body:
Syntax: title <words> | title set <words> | title color <name|0-255> | title clear

Adds a colored cosmetic title AFTER your character name on WHO, WHOIS, SCORE, room LOOK and LOOK <player>. For example: Sasuke [The Last Uchiha]. Your account name, command targeting and character name are unchanged. Titles NEVER appear in OOC chat, OOC emotes or CHATLOG.

Set up to 40 plain-text characters. TITLE COLOR accepts red, green, yellow, blue, cyan, magenta, purple, white, gray, orange, pink, gold, or a 0-255 palette value. TITLE shows the current result; TITLE CLEAR removes it. Changes save immediately and persist after relog/reboot.
